purpose: Fresh, initialization-paired rerun of prediction-connected Mamba2AutoCon on PEMS07 H12.
research_question: With every shared parameter initialized bit-identically, does routing the AutoCon representation into the Mamba2 forecast improve validation accuracy without invalidating the low-latency resource profile?
selection_history: The preceding two-seed screen is excluded because the optional branch changed legacy prediction-layer initialization order. This rerun fixes the construction order, asserts common-state equality in unit tests, and uses three new seeds.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory screen. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: This screen cannot establish cross-dataset, long-horizon, graph-aware, or publication-level superiority.
prelaunch_gates: verify PEMS07 fingerprint and M feature geometry
verify unit-tested bit-identical common initialization for the paired control and fusion graphs
pair the exact Mamba2AutoCon control with the prediction-connected treatment using new seeds
retain the synchronized RTX 5090 D resource probe as the efficiency evidence
stop if treatment is more than 1% worse than the control mean

phases.name: pems07_h12_mamba2_autocon_null_paired
phases.purpose: Exact Mamba2AutoCon control with the auxiliary AutoCon objective and no prediction fusion.

phases.name: pems07_h12_mamba2_autocon_fusion_paired
phases.purpose: Mamba2AutoCon with the zero-initialized prediction-connected AutoCon representation residual.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: prediction-connected fusion versus exact Mamba2AutoCon control
comparison_contract.resource_contract: Report synchronized GPU latency, parameters and peak memory for both branches and frozen baselines.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, cross-dataset, long-horizon, or publication claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, seeds, or budget after launch.
If fusion exceeds the exact control mean by more than 1%, stop and do not promote.
Do not release test metrics from this screen.
